commands.command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 'set -euo pipefail; cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps; b=backups/local-20260912-111259; test $(systemctl is-active photomap.service) = active; test $(git rev-parse HEAD) = dcd99f07faf9e159a1b6b3f0b76ccff1e9db8ce1; test -f "$b/backend/data/app.db"; test -d "$b/backend/storage"; test -f "$b/local-data-diagnostics.json"; cd "$b"; find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > SHA256SUMS; echo remote_files=$(find . -type f | wc -l | tr -d " " ); echo remote_bytes=$(du -sb . | cut -f1); echo production_service=active'

set -euo pipefail; DEST="$HOME/Desktop/PhotoMaps-full-backup-2026-09-12-052"; PART="$DEST.part"; test ! -e "$DEST"; rm -rf "$PART"; mkdir -p "$PART"; rsync -a --partial --info=progress2 -e "ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10" michal@192.168.0.23:/home/michal/src/PhotoMaps/backups/local-20260912-111259/ "$PART/"; cd "$PART"; shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS >/tmp/photomap-backup-052-sha-check.txt; entries=$(wc -l < SHA256SUMS | tr -d ' '); files=$(find . -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$files" -eq $((entries + 1)); python3 -c 'import sqlite3; c=sqlite3.connect("backend/data/app.db"); r=c.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]; assert r=="ok", r; print("backup_db_integrity=ok"); print("backup_alembic="+c.execute("SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version").fetchone()[0]); print("backup_photos="+str(c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo").fetchone()[0])); print("backup_places="+str(c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place").fetchone()[0])); c.close()'; bytes=$(du -sk . | cut -f1); cd ..; mv "$PART" "$DEST"; echo backup_local=$DEST; echo backup_files=$files; echo backup_bytes_approx=$((bytes * 1024)); echo full_backup_to_mac_verified
